subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Lists items experienced with each sense and items experienced with more than one sense

show.line: Popcorn! I see it, hear it pop, smell it, taste it and touch it!

rounds.prompt: A drum goes boom! Which sense?
Do we hear it or smell it? Sort them.
Which one do we feel with our fingers? It is rough.
An orange! Can you name a sense we use for it?

rounds.story: Sipho smells smoke in the kitchen. Something is burning! Which sense warned Sipho?
rounds.praise: His nose! Our senses keep us safe.

hints: Some things use more than one sense.
Ask: do I look, listen, sniff, taste or touch?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will listen to the rainbow.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I hear the rainbow with my ears!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We see a rainbow with our eyes.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: A rainbow is for looking. We use our eyes!

parent_line: Can match things in the world to the sense used to notice them.
